mapper.sql: FROM dish d INNER JOIN merchant m ON m.id = d.merchant_id INNER JOIN stall s ON s.id = d.stall_id INNER JOIN canteen c ON c.id = d.canteen_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.status IN ('ON_SALE', 'SOLD_OUT') AND m.apply_status = 'APPROVED' AND m.status = 'OPEN' AND s.status = 'OPEN' AND c.status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT merchant_id FROM dish WHERE id = #{dishId} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status != 'DELETED'

SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, su.nickname AS userNickname, su.avatar_url AS userAvatar, r.target_type AS targetType, r.dish_id AS targetId, r.dish_id AS dishId, d.name AS dishName, r.overall_score AS overallScore, r.taste_score AS tasteScore, r.portion_score AS portionScore, r.value_score AS valueScore, r.content, r.is_anonymous AS isAnonymous, r.like_count AS likeCount, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = r.user_id INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(overall_score), 2), 0) AS averageScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(taste_score), 2), 0) AS tasteScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(portion_score), 2), 0) AS portionScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(value_score), 2), 0) AS valueScore FROM review WHERE dish_id = #{dishId} AND status = 'VISIBLE'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.overall_score), 2), 0) AS averageScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.taste_score), 2), 0) AS tasteScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.portion_score), 2), 0) AS portionScore, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(r.value_score), 2), 0) AS valueScore FROM review r INNER JOIN dish d ON d.id = r.dish_id WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND r.status = 'VISIBLE'
mapper.update: UPDATE dish SET review_count = #{reviewCount}, average_score = #{averageScore}, taste_score = #{tasteScore}, portion_score = #{portionScore}, value_score = #{valueScore} WHERE id = #{dishId}
